paragraphs.text: Kardur , also known as the Doomscourge , is a fearsome demon berserker hailing from Kaldheim .

The demons of Immersturm are notorious for their brutal Viking-like raids and an insatiable craving for chaos and destruction. Bound by powerful runes placed by the gods to imprison them within this harsh realm, the demon jarls and their ruthless armies have waged endless, savage warfare across the desolate Fields of Elskul. Among these warlords, Kardur stood out as one of the most terrifying and relentless jarls, striking fear into both allies and enemies alike. In a rare show of unity, the rival demon leaders combined their strength to imprison Kardur deep beneath the earth, sealing him hundreds of miles below the surface. Now, Kardur is gradually clawing his way back toward the surface, advancing slowly but surely with each passing day. When he finally emerges once more, the land of Immersturm will face devastation the likes of which have never been seen.
